title: Vent termination.
officialText:
Vent stacks or stack vents shall terminate outdoors above the roof or to the stack vent portion of the soil
or waste stack, at least 6 inches (152 mm) above the flood level of the highest fixture connection discharging into the soil or waste
stack.
